reviews.title: Spin wheel is a scam
reviews.text: It’s obvious that the spin wheel is in no way random and has 2 possible outcomes (that I’ve seen) that are just an animated image to display either a 10 point roll or 20 point roll. All numbers surrounding it are not representative of anything except to entice the end user to roll again in hopes of hitting the larger numbers playing on addictive personalities who are addicted to gambling. I’m very surprised someone hasn’t downloaded the app to a jailbroken device and used REA to reverse engineer the code and assets to prove it yet.

reviews.title: Scammers!
reviews.text:
I’m 63 and I’ve done a lot of business in my years, but I’ve never quite met a scammer on this level..

I was seduced into getting money off my gasoline, and then when I went to claim the reward, the app wouldn’t redeem it. I got a technical glitch. I contacted customer service and I’ve been working on it for a week. In an email, they (Michelle) admitted it was a system-wide problem, but they’ve made no effort to reimburse me. 

In essence, they stole my money. I don’t know how this is legal. I have screenshots to prove it. I guess we could all file a class action lawsuit, couldn’t we?

It might seem petty, but these folks should not be allowed to get away with it! I’m going to post a review on the App store as well — buyer beware!

reviews.title: Wrong information is problematic!!
reviews.text:
I do not like when a gas station says open and has a good price for gas and when I get there, it’s not even operational. 

This has happened to me quite a few times and I don’t see a way to report that the information is false. 

It’s one thing to get there and the price is way more than what was listed by someone a few minutes ago (which has happened to me also) but it’s another thing to get there and see that the gas station is not even close to being open because it’s under construction.

This is frustrating. It should be possible to share this information in real time and upload a pic so that no one else has to go through this frustration. 

Presently, I am at 780 E Schaumburg Rd & Plum Grove Rd in Schaumburg, IL showing a regular gas price of $4.28 listed by OWNER. That is unacceptable! 

Because of this, I am now becoming hesitant to rely on GasBuddy. Otherwise, the concept is great and for the times it has been reliable, I’ll give the app 2 stars. 

Please find a way for users to share information real time for situations like these.

I double‑check my information every single time I use your app, yet not once—not once—has your pricing been accurate. After many attempts over a long period, your listed fuel prices are consistently wrong, and not by a small margin. Today your app showed Shell premium at $5.89, and only 1.5 hours later the actual price was $6.49.
A difference of a few cents is understandable. A difference of 60 cents per gallon is not. This is misinformation, plain and simple.
Your “advertised” prices are unreliable, misleading, and have cost me time and money. I no longer have any faith in your service. I am deleting and blocking your app permanently.
You should compensate customers for the false information you publish.

reviews.title: Points system does NOT work
reviews.text:
I mainly use GasBuddy to find the prices of gas stations nearby, and it’s very good for that. Unfortunately, if you’re using the app to do offers and earn points for gift cards, you’d be better off doing it somewhere else. Half the offers I do never give the points they promise. And if you send them a support request it’ll take over a week to hear from them. Their only response? “It already gave you the points” when it did NOT. On top of that, you sometimes have to wait two weeks after it says the offer is completed to even claim the points, and you have to claim them within a short time window before they disappear forever. Overall, this app is very scammy but if you’re only using it to find local gas prices, then it may be worth downloading for you.

Update: I lowered my rating from 3 stars to 1 star because now I can’t even redeem a gift card. It says I need to add a phone number, then when I add the phone number, it says there’s already a phone number linked to my account. I go to my account settings and it does the same thing. I also contacted support again about my issues trying to claim points from offers, and I have gotten no response (it’s been over a week). DO NOT download this scam.

reviews.title: You don’t get the savings you think you do!
reviews.text: 1st off, when you link your bank account to you gas buddy card it takes 5 day to clear. In the app you can monitor original pump total will show as pending. Then in a few days another amount will show. This amount will be whatever THEY want to charge you. It will not be the 18 cent flash deal or the original deal you accepted on the app. This is probably why it takes so long for these transactions to clear your linked bank account. After 5 days for 1 transaction to clear most people forget OR will not track the deal gas buddy agreed to. It’s honestly a waste of time. You know, the TIME you use to sit and SEARCH the best deals. Yet you will not get the deal you ACTIVATED AND THEY AGREED TO!  I’ve been tracking this for 3 or more months. I commute over 500 miles in my 4 day work week , so this does matter to me. Just waiting for the honesty from another BS APP. I’m better off getting the cash back on my credit card. Save huge amounts of time searching BS deals. C.J. Temple , TX

reviews.title: Glitches with login
reviews.text:
Over the last month I downloaded GasBuddy after not using it for over 5 years and I tried logging in using my existing email and account. It takes me through the screen to send an email link and I never receive one, even after clicking “send email link again.” I’ve tried this on both the app on my iPhone and on Google Chrome and safari browsers, and there is no email in my spam or junk folder. I’ve also tried deleting and reinstalling the app on my phone and that has not worked either. GasBuddy support has not been helpful and have sent me generic instructions telling me to use the send email link for login purposes, which just makes me go in a circle. There isn’t someone on the customer service side who can manually push an email link to me so I can access my account. In the end I resorted to creating a new account with another email. 

The other problem I’m having now is that on the iPhone app when I try to add my vehicle by either make and model or by VIN, it doesn’t allow me to add it and erases the information after I hit submit. Then after checking, my vehicle information was not saved. How is this app supposed to help with recalls and send notifications if you can’t add your vehicle to your account? I’m really disappointed in this as I wanted to save money on gas given the prices are so high now in the US. Update your app GasBuddy and provide better customer service.

reviews.title: Good, but could be better
reviews.text:
I've used this app for probably 8 years. Is accurate most of the time. Like other users, I have suggested a number of improvements, but they have been very slow to come and when they do, they are minor. They did finally add cash and credit pricing, and user ID and date of updates. Many of us have recommended adding propane and non-ethanol premium prices for the last 5+ years...best they've done is add existence of propane in notes for stations...still no pricing or search capability for either.  Also, no way to add that info in notes. No way to flag stations that post bogus prices either. No station hours, and limited integration with map program...will enable directions, but station information is based solely on address or coordinates, no additional info available without searching for station name in map program.  But there really isn't a better gas price app in US right now, so we'll have to live with the shortcomings for now.

UPDATE:
I down graded my rating for a couple reasons. It seems like pricing updates are required too often and many stations have no pricing available. Secondly, I will find a station with a low price, yet when I search the area and sort by lowest price, that station will not show up. Not sure if this is because that station doesn’t pay the app provider for their listing or something else, but it means you can’t rely on the search function.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work, outdated store status, FAR LESS discount compared to directly using station apps
reviews.text: SO much doesn’t work anymore, and the discounts are a lie.  Company appears to have abandoned the app. Deal alerts don’t work. You activate, use within time frame, and nothing… no gas back credit. This app has become a fraud. They still haven’t added non ethanol fuel pricing, despite many of us requesting it for YEARS, and if you use with fuel logs, it won’t let you record non ethanol to get the right mpg (bug: it auto corrects to regular ethanol, which is incorrect).  They also don’t tell you the TRUE gas back process - it takes two to three WEEKS - they send you 2 deposits to verify, but it doesn’t stop there - they then say more verification is needed after you confirm - they withdraw the money next day, but a week later they say are still WAITING on the deposits and you still don’t get the credit - huh?  You also can’t get any discounts until you get your GB discount card. I did everything right in the app, scanned receipt, etc, and I didn’t get the 33c discount they advertised. I researched discounts, and GB is WAY less than using individual gas store apps where you see and immediately get your discounts right after sign up - use your credit cards and no need to link a bank account or use a physical pay card - other gas station discounts are much better than GB! GB is an unneeded middle man who gets your data for free and pays you essentially nothing. I deleted my account, then resigned up for free.
